name: no-legal-waiver-wallpaper
description: Two skills for writing that other people or agents will read. no-legal-waiver-wallpaper strips the caveat sections, hedges and self-undermining closers from anything an agent writes for someone else; doubt goes to the user in chat, the document carries what was asked for and nothing else. pseudoprompt turns a long prose ask into a pseudocode prompt in one copy-paste block, carrying what the paragraph said and nothing else.
